description:
Sets a new player password with the single-use reset token received by email and revokes existing sessions.
Use when: the player explicitly confirms their new password after requesting horizon_forgot_password.
Not for: verification tokens (use horizon_verify_email), account discovery or automatic password changes.
Side effects: consumes the reset token, replaces the password and revokes all player sessions including refresh families. Clear corresponding local credentials and use horizon_signin_email again.
Returns: empty HTTP 200 represented as null; no session or password is returned.
Errors: 400 for an invalid/expired reset token, an out-of-range password or a rejected common password. Obtain a fresh reset email only at the player's request. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

newPassword.description: New password explicitly chosen by the player, 8 to 128 characters; common passwords are rejected; never returned

token.description: Single-use token from the player's verification or password-reset email (max 256 characters)

name: horizon_reset_password
title: Reset Player Password
